facts.summary: Paused Phase 3 enrollment after blinded pooled analysis showed lower than expected efficacy · Phase 2/3 · epetraborole in treatment-refractory MAC lung disease · not yet approved
facts.indication: treatment-refractory Mycobacterium avium complex (MAC) lung disease

evidence.summary: The voluntary pause was instituted following a blinded aggregate analysis of the ongoing Phase 2 study, including pooled patients from both treatment arms, which showed potentially lower than expected efficacy.
evidence.safety: The decision was not due to safety concerns.
evidence.program_discontinued: Patients already enrolled in the Phase 2/3 trial will be allowed to continue on study.
